description: This file is a Node.js script that is used for measuring and asserting the startup memory usage (RSS) of the openclaw application under various test scenarios. It sets up environment conditions, runs subprocess commands, and processes their resource usage metrics to verify against specified limits.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates a guidance message for fixing startup memory issues based on the test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a failure message including guidance on next steps for fixing startup memory issues.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum Resident Set Size (RSS) from stderr output, returning it in MB.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Builds and returns an environment variable object for running the subprocess commands in a controlled environment.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a test case by spawning a child process, checks the resource usage report, and throws errors if limits are exceeded or errors are detected.
